title: Build From Scratch
story: The components are on the board with no wires at all. Connect the complete circuit from the left rail to the right rail.
concept: A complete circuit requires three connections: Rail L to switch, switch to lamp, and lamp to Rail R.

learn.title: Three Wires
learn.text: Every basic rung connects: Left rail -> Input contact -> Output coil -> Right rail.

steps.explanation: Lamp is OFF when button is unpressed.
Lamp turns ON when button is pressed.
Lamp turns OFF when button is released.

hints: Connect Rail L to the START button's left side.
Connect START button's right side to LAMP's left side.
Connect LAMP's right side to Rail R.
